stops.modernZh: 江西于都渡河地段
stops.summaryZh: 中央红军各部和中央机关分批渡河，离开集结地域西进。
stops.summaryEn: Army units and central organs crossed in separate groups and moved west.
stops.resultZh: 完成出发阶段渡河。
stops.resultEn: The departure crossings were completed.
stops.terrainZh: 于都河亦称贡水，使用浮桥与船渡。
stops.terrainEn: The river, also called Gongshui, was crossed by pontoon bridges and boats.
stops.dateNoteZh: 17日起分批夜渡；20日晚至21日拂晓为结束口径，不是全军同日从一处出发。
stops.dateNoteEn: Crossings began on the 17th; the final night ended around dawn on the 21st. Units used different dates and crossings.
stops.locationNoteZh: 代表于都河沿岸多处渡口，不是单一东门渡口。
stops.actZh: 一 · 于都出发与突破封锁

stops.modernZh: 江西信丰南北桃江沿线
stops.summaryZh: 各部先后通过信丰南北桃江防线，继续西进。
stops.summaryEn: Units passed the Tao River defenses around Xinfeng and continued west.
stops.resultZh: 突破第一道封锁线。
stops.resultEn: The first blockade line was passed.
stops.terrainZh: 渡河地段分布在信丰南北，非一处桥头。
stops.terrainEn: Crossings occupied a region north and south of Xinfeng.
stops.dateNoteZh: 日期是分批行动区间。
stops.dateNoteEn: Dates cover movements by different units.

stops.modernZh: 湖南汝城与广东仁化城口之间
stops.summaryZh: 红军从汝城、城口之间通过湘粤边防线。
stops.summaryEn: The column passed between Rucheng and Chengkou on the provincial border.
stops.resultZh: 打开继续西行的通道。
stops.resultEn: The westward movement continued.
stops.terrainZh: 这是跨湘粤边的突破地段。
stops.terrainEn: The crossing area straddled the Hunan–Guangdong border.
stops.locationNoteZh: 区域代表点，不是全军进入汝城县城的记录。

stops.modernZh: 郴州、良田、宜章与乐昌之间
stops.summaryZh: 中央红军通过湘南、粤北间的防线，向湘江方向行动。
stops.summaryEn: The army passed the southern Hunan defenses toward the Xiang River.
stops.resultZh: 继续向桂北推进。
stops.resultEn: The column advanced toward northern Guangxi.
stops.terrainZh: 涉及多个县镇的区域通道。
stops.terrainEn: The movement covered several towns and counties.
stops.locationNoteZh: 不能理解为所有部队依次进入所列每座城镇。

stops.modernZh: 广西全州—兴安之间
stops.summaryZh: 各部争夺渡口、实施阻击，掩护主力与军委纵队渡江。
stops.summaryEn: Crossing operations and blocking actions protected the main column.
stops.battleZh: 界首、凤凰嘴等渡点与脚山铺、光华铺、新圩阻击相互配合。
stops.battleEn: Crossings at Jieshou and Fenghuangzui relied on blocking actions at several positions.
stops.resultZh: 突破第四道封锁线，但遭严重减员。
stops.resultEn: The fourth blockade was broken at severe cost.
stops.terrainZh: 渡口与两翼掩护阵地共同制约渡江进程。
stops.terrainEn: Crossing points and flanking positions jointly shaped the operation.
stops.dateNoteZh: 主要战斗为27日至12月1日；25日已有抢渡部署。人数前后差不能等同本战阵亡数。
stops.dateNoteEn: Major fighting ran from 27 November to 1 December; crossing orders preceded it on the 25th. Strength reductions are not a battle death count.
stops.locationNoteZh: 代表全州—兴安渡河区域，不是战役全部阵地边界。

stops.modernZh: 广西越城岭相关山地
stops.summaryZh: 军委纵队及各部先后翻越越城岭山地，继续向龙胜方向前进。
stops.summaryEn: Different columns crossed the Yuecheng mountain region toward Longsheng.
stops.resultZh: 离开湘江渡河地域，进入山地行军阶段。
stops.resultEn: The column continued through mountain terrain.
stops.terrainZh: 各部翻越路线和通过时间不同。
stops.terrainEn: Units used different crossings and schedules.
stops.dateNoteZh: 4日下午起至6日为不同梯队的通过口径。
stops.dateNoteEn: The interval covers separate columns from the afternoon of the 4th through the 6th.
stops.locationNoteZh: 越城岭地名范围示意，不定位猫儿山最高峰，也不认定一条唯一山路。

stops.modernZh: 湖南通道县域
stops.summaryZh: 讨论行军方向后，部队转向贵州；放弃湘西原定方案的正式决定见后续黎平会议。
stops.summaryEn: The column turned toward Guizhou; the Liping meeting later formalized a new direction.
stops.resultZh: 行动方向向西调整。
stops.resultEn: The movement shifted west.
stops.terrainZh: 发生在湘桂黔边行动地域。
stops.terrainEn: The decision arose in the Hunan–Guangxi–Guizhou border region.
stops.dateNoteZh: 采用通行的12日说，研究中另有日期讨论。
stops.dateNoteEn: The commonly used date is the 12th; scholarly discussion includes alternatives.
stops.locationNoteZh: 具体会址有县溪、流源等说法；县域定位不等于恭城书院已获证实的精确会址。
stops.actZh: 二 · 转向黔北与遵义会议

stops.modernZh: 贵州黎平会议会址地域
stops.summaryZh: 政治局会议否定继续前往湘西的原定计划，决定向黔北发展。
stops.summaryEn: The Politburo chose northern Guizhou instead of the planned western Hunan destination.
stops.resultZh: 明确遵义及川黔边方向。
stops.resultEn: Zunyi and the Sichuan–Guizhou border became the new direction.
stops.terrainZh: 会议在入黔后的黎平县城召开。
stops.terrainEn: The meeting took place after the column entered Guizhou.
stops.dateNoteZh: 会议日不等于各部进出黎平的同一天。
stops.dateNoteEn: The meeting date is not a common arrival date for all units.

stops.modernZh: 贵州瓮安猴场宋家湾一带
stops.summaryZh: 会议重申向黔北发展的方向，确定渡过乌江后的行动方针。
stops.summaryEn: The meeting reaffirmed the northern Guizhou direction and plans beyond the Wu River.
stops.resultZh: 统一突破乌江后的行动方向。
stops.resultEn: The post-crossing direction was clarified.
stops.terrainZh: 处于北进乌江前的行动地域。
stops.terrainEn: Houchang lay in the approach region south of the Wu River.
stops.dateNoteZh: 跨年夜会议，采用31日晚至元旦凌晨口径。
stops.dateNoteEn: The meeting spanned New Year's Eve and the early hours of 1 January.
stops.locationNoteZh: 今猴场镇；草塘镇已于2010年更名，不能反写为今草塘镇。

stops.placeEn: Northern crossing of the Wu River
stops.modernZh: 江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口群
stops.summaryZh: 各部从不同渡点突破乌江，先渡部队向遵义推进。
stops.summaryEn: Separate crossings opened the route north toward Zunyi.
stops.battleZh: 抢渡与架桥分点进行，不是全军只争夺一座桥。
stops.battleEn: Assault crossings and bridge building occurred at several points.
stops.resultZh: 主力通过乌江进入黔北。
stops.resultEn: The main force entered northern Guizhou.
stops.terrainZh: 渡点分布在峡谷河段，现代水库已改变部分渡口面貌。
stops.terrainEn: Crossings occupied gorge reaches, some later altered by reservoirs.
stops.dateNoteZh: 2—4日为部分突破阶段；6日为主力全部过江口径。
stops.dateNoteEn: Some accounts date the breakthrough to the 2nd–4th; the 6th marks main-force completion.
stops.locationNoteZh: 多渡口地段代表点，不是某一渡口的测绘坐标。

stops.modernZh: 贵州遵义会议会址附近
stops.summaryZh: 会议总结此前军事失利，调整中央领导及军事指挥安排。
stops.summaryEn: The conference reviewed military setbacks and changed leadership and command arrangements.
stops.resultZh: 增选毛泽东为政治局常委；后续分工继续在行军中完成。
stops.resultEn: Mao joined the Politburo Standing Committee; later command arrangements continued to evolve.
stops.terrainZh: 会议在已被红军控制的遵义城内召开。
stops.terrainEn: The conference met in a town already held by the Red Army.
stops.dateNoteZh: 7日先头占城、9日中央与主力进入，不等于15日会议开始。
stops.dateNoteEn: Vanguard entry on the 7th and central/main-force arrival on the 9th preceded the conference.

stops.modernZh: 贵州习水土城附近
stops.summaryZh: 红军攻击尾追川军，未能达到预期歼敌目标。
stops.summaryEn: An attack on pursuing Sichuan forces did not achieve its intended result.
stops.battleZh: 结束攻击后，组织向赤水河西岸转移。
stops.battleEn: The column disengaged and prepared to cross west of the Chishui.
stops.resultZh: 转入渡河机动。
stops.resultEn: The operation shifted to a river-crossing maneuver.
stops.terrainZh: 战场位于土城附近赤水河东侧山地。
stops.terrainEn: The fighting occupied hills east of the river near Tucheng.
stops.dateNoteZh: 与29日凌晨起的渡河行动分别列示。
stops.dateNoteEn: The battle and the following crossing are separate events.
stops.actZh: 三 · 四渡赤水与黔北机动

stops.modernZh: 土城、猿猴场（今元厚）等地段
stops.summaryZh: 各部分路西渡赤水河，向川南机动。
stops.summaryEn: Units crossed westward at several points and moved into southern Sichuan.
stops.resultZh: 脱离土城战场。
stops.resultEn: The column left the Tucheng battlefield.
stops.terrainZh: 从河东向河西，多渡点分批通行。
stops.terrainEn: The crossing ran from the eastern to western bank at several sites.
stops.locationNoteZh: 土城为代表地段；猿猴场今元厚，不是赤水市城区。

stops.modernZh: 云南威信水田寨、大河滩、扎西等地
stops.summaryZh: 转进扎西期间连续开会，讨论领导分工、部队组织和行动方向。
stops.summaryEn: Meetings during the maneuver addressed command, organization and the next move.
stops.resultZh: 形成后续机动与组织调整安排。
stops.resultEn: Plans for further movement and reorganization followed.
stops.terrainZh: 这是川滇黔边的系列会议地域。
stops.terrainEn: The meetings occupied several sites in the three-province border region.
stops.dateNoteZh: 不是全军在同一会场连续休整五日。
stops.dateNoteEn: The dates do not imply a five-day halt by every unit at one venue.
stops.locationNoteZh: 扎西地区代表点；系列会议场所与鸡鸣三省会址考证分开。

stops.modernZh: 太平渡、二郎滩、九溪口等
stops.summaryZh: 红军从川南折回，分路东渡赤水河。
stops.summaryEn: The column turned back and crossed eastward through several sectors.
stops.resultZh: 重入黔北，向桐梓和遵义方向推进。
stops.resultEn: The army re-entered northern Guizhou toward Tongzi and Zunyi.
stops.terrainZh: 渡点相互分离，不是全军依次通过三座渡口。
stops.terrainEn: The sites were parallel crossings, not three successive stops for the whole army.
stops.dateNoteZh: 18日晚先头抢渡、19日中央过江、21日拂晓渡毕等口径分别对应不同梯队。
stops.dateNoteEn: The 18th, 19th and dawn of the 21st refer to different columns and completion stages.

stops.modernZh: 桐梓、娄山关、遵义及城南高地
stops.titleZh: 遵义战役与娄山关争夺
stops.summaryZh: 二渡后连续进攻，经娄山关推进遵义并击退增援。
stops.summaryEn: After the second crossing, attacks through Loushan Pass retook Zunyi and defeated reinforcements.
stops.battleZh: 战役包括关口争夺及遵义城南高地作战。
stops.battleEn: The campaign included the pass and high ground south of Zunyi.
stops.resultZh: 再占遵义，取得重要胜利。
stops.resultEn: Zunyi was retaken in an important victory.
stops.terrainZh: 关隘与城南高地共同影响攻防。
stops.terrainEn: The pass and southern heights shaped the campaign.
stops.dateNoteZh: 采用2月24—28日主要作战阶段；部分军史将全过程计至3月1日，此处按主要作战阶段标注。
stops.dateNoteEn: The dates mark the principal fighting phase, 24–28 February. Some military histories extend the full campaign to 1 March.
stops.locationNoteZh: 用娄山关地段代表多处战场，不是全部战役边界。

stops.modernZh: 贵州遵义播州区枫香镇苟坝村
stops.summaryZh: 围绕进攻打鼓新场的计划讨论，最终取消该进攻。
stops.summaryEn: Discussion of an attack on Daguxinchang led to cancellation of the plan.
stops.resultZh: 继续调整军事决策和指挥安排。
stops.resultEn: Military decision-making arrangements continued to evolve.
stops.terrainZh: 会址苟坝与目标打鼓新场（今金沙县城）不是同一地点。
stops.terrainEn: Gouba and the proposed target at modern Jinsha were different places.
stops.dateNoteZh: 采用10—12日会议区间，不将新三人指挥小组成立时点锁死在12日。
stops.dateNoteEn: The date range does not fix the later three-person command group's formation to the 12th.

stops.modernZh: 贵州仁怀茅台上、中、下渡口附近
stops.summaryZh: 鲁班场战斗后转至茅台附近，再次西渡赤水河。
stops.summaryEn: After fighting at Lubanchang, the army crossed west near Maotai.
stops.resultZh: 进入河西继续机动。
stops.resultEn: Maneuvers continued west of the river.
stops.terrainZh: 通过茅台附近多个渡点；今纪念桥不是当年原样保存的浮桥。
stops.terrainEn: Several sites were used; today's commemorative bridge is not the original pontoon bridge.
stops.dateNoteZh: 16日部署至17日渡毕的阶段口径。
stops.dateNoteEn: The interval covers deployment on the 16th and crossing completion on the 17th.

stops.modernZh: 二郎滩、九溪口、太平渡等地段
stops.summaryZh: 各部突然折回东岸，随后寻找南下机动机会。
stops.summaryEn: The army recrossed eastward before seeking a southward opening.
stops.resultZh: 为后续南渡乌江创造条件。
stops.resultEn: The maneuver prepared the following move toward the Wu River.
stops.terrainZh: 部署覆盖多个渡点，不是一座桥的往返。
stops.terrainEn: Deployment covered several crossings rather than one bridge.
stops.dateNoteZh: 21日夜主要渡河；后卫红五军团部署延续至22日上午。
stops.dateNoteEn: Main crossings took place on the night of the 21st; rear-guard orders extended into the 22nd.
stops.locationNoteZh: 太平渡作代表地段；不能据连线认定各部共同经过每一渡口。

stops.modernZh: 江口、大塘、梯子岩等渡口
stops.summaryZh: 前卫夺取渡口，主力随后南渡，使主要追堵力量留在江北。
stops.summaryEn: The vanguard seized crossings and the main force moved south of the river.
stops.resultZh: 转入贵阳外围机动。
stops.resultEn: The next maneuver approached the Guiyang region.
stops.terrainZh: 梯子岩岸陡江窄，夺渡后架桥。
stops.terrainEn: The narrow, steep-sided Tiziyan reach supported bridge construction after seizure.
stops.dateNoteZh: 29日起前卫夺渡，主力核心渡江日为31日；部分编述延至4月1日。
stops.dateNoteEn: Vanguard action began on the 29th; the main crossing centered on the 31st, with some accounts extending to 1 April.
stops.locationNoteZh: 历史渡口群代表点，现代水库岸线不能直接当作1935年河面。
stops.actZh: 四 · 渡金沙江与大渡河
stops.actEn: IV · The Jinsha and Dadu crossings

stops.modernZh: 贵州贵阳北部及外围
stops.summaryZh: 以一部兵力佯攻息烽，前锋威胁贵阳并示形清水江方向。
stops.summaryEn: A feint at Xifeng and threats toward Guiyang drew opposing movements.
stops.resultZh: 促使追堵部队增援、东调；没有攻克贵阳。
stops.resultEn: Opposing troops redeployed; Guiyang was not captured.
stops.terrainZh: 主线采用实际经过的外围地域，不进入贵阳城内。
stops.terrainEn: The route uses the approach region rather than the city center.
stops.locationNoteZh: 扎佐附近区域代表点，不是“红军攻占贵阳”的位置。

stops.modernZh: 云南昆明东北外围
stops.summaryZh: 前锋向昆明外围示形，主力转向西北寻求渡江。
stops.summaryEn: Vanguard feints toward Kunming accompanied the main force's northwestern turn.
stops.resultZh: 为渡金沙江争取条件；没有攻克昆明。
stops.resultEn: The maneuver supported the Jinsha crossing; Kunming was not captured.
stops.terrainZh: 寻甸、嵩明与大板桥前锋行动有别于进入昆明旧城。
stops.terrainEn: The approach operations were distinct from entry into Kunming's old city.
stops.dateNoteZh: 行动窗口，不是全军同日抵达同一点。
stops.dateNoteEn: Dates cover a maneuver rather than a single shared arrival.
stops.locationNoteZh: 寻甸—嵩明地域概略点，不把威胁目标画为已到达城镇。

stops.modernZh: 云南禄劝—四川会理间金沙江
stops.modernEn: Jinsha River between Luquan and Huili
stops.summaryZh: 中央红军主力集中皎平渡，依靠船工摆渡进入四川。
stops.summaryEn: The main force crossed at Jiaopingdu with local boatmen's support.
stops.resultZh: 摆脱主要追堵力量，继续北上。
stops.resultEn: The main pursuit was evaded and the northward march continued.
stops.terrainZh: 深切河谷、急流与渡运条件共同影响通行。
stops.terrainEn: The deep valley, current and ferry capacity shaped the crossing.
stops.dateNoteZh: 此处为皎平渡主渡3—9日口径；红九军团另由树桔渡通过。
stops.dateNoteEn: These dates concern the main Jiaopingdu crossing; the Ninth Corps used Shujiedu separately.
stops.locationNoteZh: 据地名与现代河段资料人工概略定位，非1935渡口测绘点。原渡口已因乌东德蓄水淹没，不能当作今日新镇或纪念馆坐标。

stops.modernZh: 四川会理城北铁厂村附近
stops.summaryZh: 总结此前军事行动，统一认识并决定继续北上。
stops.summaryEn: The meeting reviewed recent maneuvers and reaffirmed the northward direction.
stops.resultZh: 继续向大渡河及红四方面军方向行动。
stops.resultEn: The army continued toward the Dadu and the Fourth Front Army.
stops.terrainZh: 会址在会理城东北郊一带，不在县城内。
stops.terrainEn: The venue lay northeast of the town rather than within it.
stops.locationNoteZh: 纪念地附近范围锚点；会议场所曾转移，不等于某间房屋的实测位置。

stops.modernZh: 四川冕宁彝海湖畔
stops.summaryZh: 刘伯承与果基小叶丹结盟，促进先遣部队通过彝区。
stops.summaryEn: Liu Bocheng and Guoji Xiaoyedan formed an alliance supporting passage through the Yi region.
stops.resultZh: 为继续前往大渡河创造条件。
stops.resultEn: The agreement supported the advance toward the Dadu.
stops.terrainZh: 湖畔结盟地与此前经过的垭口不是同一地点。
stops.terrainEn: The lakeside alliance site and preceding mountain passes were distinct places.
stops.locationNoteZh: 彝海湖畔附近概略点，不采用故事化对话作现场实录。

stops.modernZh: 四川石棉安顺场渡河地段
stops.summaryZh: 先遣部队夺取渡口后，突击队乘船建立对岸立足点。
stops.summaryEn: After the crossing was seized, an assault party established a bridgehead by boat.
stops.battleZh: 24日晚夺渡口；25日17勇士乘船突击。
stops.battleEn: The crossing was seized on the 24th; seventeen men made the boat assault on the 25th.
stops.resultZh: 取得渡河立足点，但全军渡运仍受限制。
stops.resultEn: A bridgehead was gained, but ferrying the whole army remained difficult.
stops.terrainZh: 水急船少，随后两岸分兵北上赶夺泸定桥。
stops.terrainEn: Fast water and limited boats led to movement along both banks toward Luding Bridge.
stops.locationNoteZh: 历史渡口及对岸桃子湾区域示意，非渡船航迹。

stops.modernZh: 四川泸定大渡河桥址附近
stops.summaryZh: 红四团自西岸组织夺桥，后续铺板、跟进，控制桥梁。
stops.summaryEn: The Fourth Regiment attacked from the western bank and secured the bridge.
stops.battleZh: 22名突击队员在火力掩护下前进，与安顺场17勇士是不同战斗。
stops.battleEn: Twenty-two assault troops advanced under covering fire, a separate action from Anshunchang.
stops.resultZh: 打开主力通过大渡河的重要通道。
stops.resultEn: A key passage over the Dadu was secured.
stops.terrainZh: 西岸接近与西向东夺桥，河流和桥头影响攻防。
stops.terrainEn: Western approaches and the bridgeheads shaped the west-to-east assault.
stops.locationNoteZh: 桥址附近概略点；未复原逐时阵地或攻击路线。

stops.modernZh: 四川宝兴—小金间山地
stops.summaryZh: 先头部队与中央纵队、主力先后分批翻越雪山。
stops.summaryEn: Vanguard units, central organs and the main force crossed in separate groups.
stops.resultZh: 进入达维、懋功会合地域。
stops.resultEn: The column reached the Dawei–Maogong meeting region.
stops.terrainZh: 高寒、缺氧和补给困难；不同部队有不同山口线路。
stops.terrainEn: Cold, altitude and supply shortages affected different pass routes.
stops.dateNoteZh: 12日前锋翻越、中央与主力随后通过；与12日达维前锋会师时间重叠，不是全军一次通过。
stops.dateNoteEn: Vanguard crossings on the 12th overlap the Dawei meeting; later columns crossed afterward.
stops.locationNoteZh: 王母寨垭口相关山地示意，不把所有部队归为同一垭口。
stops.actZh: 五 · 雪山、会师与草地

stops.modernZh: 四川小金达维木城沟一带
stops.summaryZh: 红一军团二师四团与红四方面军一部首先会合。
stops.summaryEn: A Central Red Army vanguard met part of the Fourth Front Army.
stops.resultZh: 两军建立接触，主力会合随后展开。
stops.resultEn: Initial contact preceded the later main-force meeting.
stops.terrainZh: 下夹金山后的达维地区是接触地域。
stops.terrainEn: Dawei lay beyond the Jiajin crossings.
stops.dateNoteZh: 不是两军全部主力12日同时到齐。
stops.dateNoteEn: The date does not mean both whole armies arrived together.
stops.locationNoteZh: 达维会师地域概略定位；历史桥位与今纪念设施的差异待核。

stops.modernZh: 四川小金会师地域
stops.summaryZh: 中央及中央红军主力到达懋功地区，与红四方面军形成主力会合。
stops.summaryEn: Central organs and the main force reached the Maogong meeting region.
stops.resultZh: 共同北上问题进入讨论。
stops.resultEn: Planning for a joint northward movement followed.
stops.terrainZh: 属于区域会合，不是单一桥头集结。
stops.terrainEn: This was a regional meeting rather than a single bridgehead assembly.
stops.dateNoteZh: 18日主力抵达；21日另有庆祝大会。
stops.dateNoteEn: Main-force arrival on the 18th preceded a celebration on the 21st.

stops.modernZh: 四川小金两河口会议旧址地域
stops.summaryZh: 讨论会师后的战略方向，确定继续北上争取甘南。
stops.summaryEn: The conference chose continued northward movement toward southern Gansu.
stops.resultZh: 28日形成北上战略相关决定。
stops.resultEn: A strategic decision followed on the 28th.
stops.terrainZh: 两河口会址与小金县城不是同一点。
stops.terrainEn: The conference site was distinct from Xiaojin town.
stops.dateNoteZh: 26—27日讨论、28日决定，保留阶段日期。
stops.dateNoteEn: Discussion on the 26th–27th preceded the decision on the 28th.
stops.locationNoteZh: 会议旧址地域概略点，非建筑测绘坐标。

stops.modernZh: 四川松潘毛儿盖索花村一带
stops.summaryZh: 讨论北上后的发展方向，主张向洮河流域及陕甘发展。
stops.summaryEn: The meeting addressed development toward the Tao River basin and Shaanxi–Gansu.
stops.resultZh: 右路军随后从毛儿盖出发过草地。
stops.resultEn: The right column subsequently entered the grasslands.
stops.terrainZh: 原取松潘计划未实现，不能把路线画成攻克或经过松潘城。
stops.terrainEn: The plan to capture Songpan was not realized; the schematic route bypasses the town.
stops.locationNoteZh: 索花寺会址相关地域，不是松潘县城。

stops.modernZh: 四川松潘、若尔盖草地
stops.titleEn: The right column crosses the grasslands
stops.summaryZh: 中共中央随右路军北行，经过草地抵达班佑、巴西地域。
stops.summaryEn: Central organs accompanied the right column through the grasslands to the Banyou–Baxi region.
stops.resultZh: 继续寻找进入甘南的通道。
stops.resultEn: The column sought a passage into southern Gansu.
stops.battleZh: 随后包座战斗主要由红四方面军第30军、第4军一部担任，不记成中央红军独自取胜。
stops.battleEn: The later Baozuo fighting was chiefly conducted by Fourth Front Army units, not solely by the Central Red Army.
stops.terrainZh: 沼泽、河沟、低温和缺粮共同制约行军。
stops.terrainEn: Marshes, channels, cold and food shortages constrained movement.
stops.dateNoteZh: 27日终点有班佑、巴西地域口径；左右路军不能合成同一路。
stops.dateNoteEn: The endpoint is described regionally as Banyou or Baxi; left and right columns followed separate routes.
stops.locationNoteZh: 草地通过区域示意；连续精确路径未证实。

stops.modernZh: 甘肃迭部达拉乡高吉村一带
stops.summaryZh: 会议决定继续北上并缩编为陕甘支队，具体整编随后在哈达铺落实。
stops.summaryEn: The meeting decided to continue north and reorganize; implementation followed at Hadapu.
stops.resultZh: 明确下一阶段行动与编制方向。
stops.resultEn: The next movement and organizational direction were set.
stops.terrainZh: 高吉村旧址在达拉河谷北岸斜坡。
stops.terrainEn: The Gaoji site occupies a slope on the northern side of the Dala valley.
stops.locationNoteZh: 村落附近范围点，未复原屋址及河谷中的精确行军线。
stops.actZh: 六 · 打开甘南通道与陕北落脚
stops.actEn: VI · Through southern Gansu to northern Shaanxi

stops.modernZh: 甘肃迭部腊子口隘口附近
stops.summaryZh: 红四团结合正面攻击与攀崖迂回，突破隘口防线。
stops.summaryEn: Frontal attacks and a cliff-side maneuver broke the pass defenses.
stops.battleZh: 16日抵近和夜战，与17日清晨突破的表述属于同一连续作战阶段。
stops.battleEn: The approach, night fighting and early-morning breakthrough formed one operation.
stops.resultZh: 打开继续北上的通道。
stops.resultEn: The northward passage was opened.
stops.terrainZh: 狭窄峡口、桥梁和两侧陡壁影响攻防。
stops.terrainEn: The narrow gorge, bridge and cliffs shaped the fighting.
stops.dateNoteZh: 资料有16日夜与17日清晨两种口径，采用16—17日。
stops.dateNoteEn: Accounts differ between the night of the 16th and dawn of the 17th.
stops.locationNoteZh: 隘口附近概略点，不能据图线推算攻击道路或阵地边界。

stops.modernZh: 甘肃宕昌哈达铺旧址群
stops.summaryZh: 部队补充给养、了解陕甘根据地信息，落实陕甘支队整编并继续北上。
stops.summaryEn: The column resupplied, obtained information about the base area and implemented reorganization.
stops.resultZh: 22日干部会宣布向陕甘根据地进发。
stops.resultEn: A cadre meeting announced the move toward the Shaanxi–Gansu base.
stops.terrainZh: 商贸集镇有利于补给及获取报纸信息。
stops.terrainEn: The market town offered supplies and access to newspapers.
stops.dateNoteZh: 18日先遣、19日部分主力、20日中央及后续到达；22日干部会、23日离开。不是全军同日抵达。
stops.dateNoteEn: Vanguard arrival on the 18th preceded later columns and central organs; meetings followed before departure on the 23rd.
stops.locationNoteZh: 义和昌药店、关帝庙等旧址群范围，不是一个统一会议室。

stops.modernZh: 甘肃通渭榜罗镇原小学一带
stops.summaryZh: 中央政治局常委会正式确定把长征落脚点放在陕甘根据地。
stops.summaryEn: The leadership formally chose the Shaanxi–Gansu base as the march's destination.
stops.resultZh: 明确落脚陕甘的方向。
stops.resultEn: The destination was confirmed.
stops.terrainZh: 决策也依据情报与根据地存续情况，不能仅以地形解释。
stops.terrainEn: Intelligence and the base area's survival mattered alongside geography.
stops.dateNoteZh: 27日晚会议，28日另有干部传达会。
stops.dateNoteEn: The evening meeting on the 27th preceded a cadre briefing on the 28th.

stops.modernZh: 宁夏隆德—泾源相关山地
stops.summaryZh: 中央红军翻越六盘山，继续向陕北行动。
stops.summaryEn: The column crossed the Liupan Mountains and continued toward northern Shaanxi.
stops.resultZh: 向吴起镇落脚地域推进。
stops.resultEn: The army advanced toward the Wuqi region.
stops.terrainZh: 处于隆德、泾源之间的山地通行地域。
stops.terrainEn: The crossing occupied mountain terrain between Longde and Jingyuan.
stops.locationNoteZh: 山地范围示意，不采用今日纪念园位置冒充当年行军点。

stops.modernZh: 陕西吴起县城历史镇区附近
stops.summaryZh: 中共中央率陕甘支队到达陕甘根据地，中央红军主力长征至此落脚。
stops.summaryEn: Central organs and the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment reached the base area.
stops.resultZh: 本专题路线终点为19日，不延伸到1936年会师。
stops.resultEn: This route ends on the 19th, not at the separate 1936 convergence.
stops.terrainZh: 此前经铁边城一带进入陕北。
stops.terrainEn: The column approached through the Tiebiancheng region.
stops.dateNoteZh: 不是此日与红十五军团主力正式会师；部分先头出现日期与主力抵达须分开。
stops.dateNoteEn: Arrival should not be confused with a formal meeting with the Fifteenth Corps.

stops.modernZh: 头道川、二道川、平台山等区域
stops.modernEn: Valleys and heights west of Wuqi
stops.summaryZh: 陕甘支队反击尾追骑兵，解除落脚根据地的直接威胁。
stops.summaryEn: The detachment counterattacked pursuing cavalry near the base area.
stops.battleZh: 依托沟谷和高地组织反击，与19日抵达事件分开。
stops.battleEn: The action used valleys and heights and is distinct from the arrival two days earlier.
stops.resultZh: 收尾事件，不改变19日的主线终点。
stops.resultEn: An epilogue event, not a later route endpoint.
stops.terrainZh: 沟谷与山梁限制骑兵展开。
stops.terrainEn: Valleys and ridges constrained cavalry deployment.
stops.locationNoteZh: 多沟谷战区范围示意，不等于胜利山纪念设施的精确点位。
